title: Paged Out!
excerpt: Deeply technical zine. And it's free.
content_html:
PO! Web Viewer version 0.0.1-alpha

This is a very early alpha version of the viewer. Features are missing. This thing barely works. You cannot copy text. Links don't work. Mobile doesn't have ToC. And so on. Sorry! We'll keep improving it over time. You can always download the PDF on the main page BTW. Links should remain stable though (or at least auto-correcting), so feel free to link specific articles.

content_html_zh:
PO！ 网页查看器版本 0.0.1-alpha

这是查看器的非常早期的 alpha 版本。 缺少特征。 这东西勉强行得通。 您无法复制文本。 链接不起作用。 移动设备没有目录。 等等。 对不起！ 我们将随着时间的推移不断改进它。 顺便说一句，您随时可以在主页上下载 PDF。 不过，链接应保持稳定（或至少自动更正），因此请随意链接特定文章。
